name: Sandy Brown
lede: Sandy Brown is a warm light orange-brown, one of the 140 named colors in the X11 web set.

sections.title: Sand, in a web palette
sections.body:
Paterson lists SandyBrown as one of the 140 colours in the X11 set, hex code #F4A460 [1]. The index places it among browns with an asterisk for X11, as do Rosy Brown and Saddle Brown [2]. The plain word *sandy* is defined as having the colour of sand [1].

The books record no earlier history for the name, so it reads as a screen-era standard [1]. Related entries include [[sand]] and [[sandstone]] [1][2]. Paterson also notes that *sandstone* is a reddish brown and that *sand* is a light yellowy-grey, so even the sand family spreads across several hues [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: In our archive of 23,781 paintings, 56 hold this color at 5% of the canvas or more, as photographed [3]. The earliest sample is an Indian miniature of Shiva and King Bana, 1840 [3]. The match counts any painting with this color covering at least a twentieth of the canvas, so it shows where the color appears in photographs of paintings, not that the painters ever called it by this name.
